title: ElytraDuraPlus
description: ElytraDurabilityPlus reduces or disables Elytra durability loss on Paper 1.21.11 servers, including optional firework protection. It also supports configurable passive Elytra repair through a simple config.yml.
body:
ElytraDurabilityPlus is a lightweight Paper 1.21.11 plugin that gives server owners full control over Elytra durability. Reduce or completely disable durability loss, prevent firework boosting from damaging Elytras, and optionally enable passive repair while gliding.

Features:

* Configurable Elytra durability multiplier
* Optional firework durability protection
* Passive Elytra auto-repair system
* Lightweight and optimized for performance
* Simple and fully customizable config.yml
* Reload command support
* Built for Paper 1.21.11

Perfect for survival servers, SMPs, and communities that want longer-lasting Elytras without removing the fun of flight.

Made with ❤️ by DeQuackDealer
